scope: GAWALL/NAWALL and every available animation with null/false shadow metadata; all second-half source frames decoded, representative native RGBA samples.
caveat: A binary index1 silhouette maps blue under raw unittem PAL; that RGB is not evidence of a genuine color frame. Multiple nonzero indices or index>1 establish that binary-shadow treatment alters original pixels. Null Shadow metadata alone does not declare whether a SHP has a shadow half.
